capabilities: Log energy levels per time slot by picking a color from four levels
Record activities in each slot as energizing, neutral, or draining
Export a text file with a built-in AI prompt for ChatGPT or Claude analysis
Customize the 6 daily time slots' start and end hours
Switch the interface between English and Chinese and reset experiment data
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese interface; data is stored in the plugin's data.json rather than as Markdown notes, so it lives outside regular vault files. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track daily energy levels and how activities affect them over an extended period.
